11.by: Claude, play.html benchmark() in the Claude desktop browser pane on an Apple M3 laptop (integrated GPU), pane hidden; not a human-observed frame counter
11.note: N4.2 re-measure with the place art in (texture arrays for walls and floors, place heights, containers and kiosks, tree crowns, name signs, wall art), Medium, 1920x1080 at pixel ratio 1, GPU forced to finish every frame, camera turning a full circle, two runs each, in one session. District 20 (TIDE, midnight rain): mean 6.8 / 8.5 ms, p95 12.0 / 13.6 ms, 143 draw calls. District 30 (MOSS): mean 6.4 / 7.6 ms, p95 11.0 / 12.8 ms, 120 calls, 201k triangles. District 100 (unchanged fallback art, the control): mean 5.9 / 7.5 ms, p95 9.3 / 12.9 ms, 132 calls. The machine ran about 1.5 ms slower than at build 29 (district 100 then: 4.7-6.5 ms), so the place art itself costs about 1 ms. All under the 16.7 ms budget and the 150-call cap. Build 29 (N4.1): district 20 mean 3.7 ms, 141 calls. Weaker laptops and phones: not measured.
